pages.text: Consuming grants biomass and EP, each equal to 25% of the target’s maximum health. Ordinary kills pay half the consumption reward by default. Evolution points purchase skills; biomass powers the nest and death reconstruction. Hold transform and choose the aggregate to shed your shell. Feed to rebuild, or tap transform to return to a safe, loaded shell.

To survive a lethal hit as an aggregate, be infected, enter Prototype mode and keep at least 150 biomass in reserve by default. An ordinary lethal hit spends that reserve. Damage that bypasses invulnerability skips the transformation. Servers can change the cost.

A death aggregate has no shell to recall. Touch living, consumable prey and let the aggregate envelop it. Leave room to stand when you reform. The base lifetime is 45 seconds. Viral Stability I extends it to 75 seconds, II to 120 seconds, and III removes natural decay.
